ONE GPU WITNESS BINARY (COHESION §0gy.6, X.W11.lhb 2026-10-31): collect.chromePath is the installed Google Chrome, the binary e2e/smoke/perf/real-gpu.ts launches (Playwright channel "chrome" resolves to this path on darwin; Chrome 156 when this was written), with the same --use-angle=metal, so every value.js GPU cell reads with one instrument. NAMED-WITNESS NEED (machine law: branded Chrome only where a named witness needs it): this is a GPU measurement on ANGLE Metal, which the default chrome-headless-shell has no path to, and Chrome for Testing 148 (the binary this cell ran before) stalls one 192-391 ms readback task inside glass's dock sampler on a new browser that Chrome 156 does not (value.js INBOX O-123, glass INBOUND O-117 placed at W-G.3 / W-G.6 for 11.0.0); the stall is recorded on O-123 as its evidence, not hidden by this choice. chrome-launcher starts the binary on its own fresh temporary --user-data-dir, never the owner's Chrome profile. The browser version is recorded in every reading: each LHR carries environment.hostUserAgent (Chrome/<version>), and the reading of record prints it per collect, so a host auto-update shows in the record. Run it as a browser run, never --light, at the COHESION §0gx.3 load condition (1-minute load <= 12 at the start and end of each draw, else wait <= 60 min and record UNMEASURED-LOADED): ~/.claude/guard/guarded --timeout 30 --cpu-cores 0 -- npx --yes @lhci/cli@0.15.x autorun --config=lighthouserc.gpu.json. The gate is TBT <= 300 GREEN on two such runs. PAINT STATE (COHESION §0gw.5): the flags carry --disable-field-trial-config, as Playwright's launch (and so real-gpu.ts) always does; without it the cell produced no frames while the host display slept (evidence/browser/hyg-2026-10-29/paint-state-discriminator.txt). --headless=new is not listed because LHCI appends it itself; listing it too made chrome-launcher pass --headless=new,new.
